status: User approved all four exact GCC 15 diagnostic sites on 2026-10-05; normal compiler flags and raw diagnostics retained.
approval: User approved on 2026-10-05: Allow these four documented diagnostics. Scope is the recorded GCC 15 V8 FFT allocation warning and three SQLite optimizer warnings only; normal compiler flags remain enabled.
scope: One V8 FFT array-allocation diagnostic and three SQLite optimizer diagnostics in the bundled Node 24.18.1 sources. Preserve normal compiler flags and code; no suppression.

v8_fft.site: deps/v8/src/bigint/mul-fft.cc:434, FFTContainer part_ allocation, inlined into DoPointwiseMultiplication
v8_fft.root_cause: The optimized GCC tree contains its own overflow fallback operator new[](SIZE_MAX). The array count is n=1<<m, where m=min(ctz(K),bit_length(K)-4). The caller permits this path only for K>=199 and K divisible by four, so m>=2 and m<=27 for a positive 32-bit K. Therefore n is positive and at most 2^27; the pointer array fits far below GCC's overflow-guard bound. The compiler warns about its synthesized overflow fallback, not a computed runtime SIZE_MAX value.
v8_fft.control: Exact original translation unit and standalone original-source harness both reproduce the warning. 4,309 outer and 4,073 recursive parameter checks cover powers-of-two boundaries through the V8 maximum digit limit. Thirty 1,500–8,192-digit FFT products/squares match independent schoolbook multiplication for random, all-one, and sparse operands. Valgrind frees all 9,100 allocations with zero errors.

sqlite_collation.root_cause: The reported branch assumes COLFLAG_HASTYPE is set with a NULL zCnName. sqlite3SubqueryColumnTypes clears HASTYPE/HASCOLL before testing the realloc result and sets HASTYPE only after successful allocation. The failed-allocation branch cannot supply that combination.
sqlite_collation.control: 250 allocation-failure positions cover typed/untyped collated columns and a view; only SQLITE_OK/SQLITE_NOMEM, with clean Valgrind and UBSan.

sqlite_geopoly.root_cause: geopolyBBox has a separate NULL-pointer input mode that consumes preexisting bounds. The aggregate callback always passes argv[0], a non-NULL SQLite value object even for SQL NULL. For this mode, successful polygon decoding writes all four bounds before returning; invalid/NULL values return without consuming them.
sqlite_geopoly.control: Valid polygons, SQL NULL and malformed polygon rows give the expected aggregate area; Valgrind/UBSan clean.

sqlite_foreign_key.root_cause: The SQLITE_DBSTATUS_DEFERRED_FKS case unconditionally writes pCurrent and pHighwater for the valid connection. Its return is SQLITE_OK; nFk is assigned on the only supported opcode path.
sqlite_foreign_key.control: An actual changeset with one missing parent invokes the FK conflict callback with exactly one violation; clean Valgrind/UBSan.

compiler_reproduction: The exact patched SQLite translation unit is clean with the RPM release -O2 command and reproduces precisely these three warnings with the upstream Node test-build -O3 command.
